title: Vox-Style Editorial Collage Design System
text: For serious explainer topics, use a textured cream grid canvas (`#D8D6D0`, 40px grid) paired with monochrome photo cutouts offset by solid terracotta silhouette shadows (`#CA4D2D`, offset X:-18px, Y:-14px). Emphasize key evidence using animated golden-yellow highlighter sweeps (`#EFBC22` with `mix-blend-mode: multiply` scaling X:0 to 1) and numeric odometer counters rolling via GSAP `onUpdate`.
how: Incorporate these CSS styles and helper animations into `compose_lab.py` for Kaise Tech AI/tech investigations and historical explainers on Aage Suno.

title: Shot-Scale Jump Contrast Rule
text: Avoid imperceptible 2-3% continuous camera drifts that feel like static presentation slides. Motivated zooming must execute true shot-scale transitions: switch between establishing wide shots (subject occupying ~35% of frame height) and medium close-ups or close-ups (subject occupying 55-65% frame height, zoom factor >= 1.08), followed by a 0.5s hold per voiceover beat.
how: Update visual instructions in `plan.py` and camera tween presets in `compose_lab.py` to use discrete focal scale steps rather than faint background drift.

title: Timeline-Mined SFX Cue Generation
text: Instead of manually scripting audio cues, inspect the GSAP master timeline (`window.__timelines['main']`) in headless Chrome, classify tweens into sound families based on property changes (camera moves to whoosh, entrance to impact, text reveal to paper/click), and output frame-snapped cue timestamps. Then mix stem layers and mux onto the final MP4 using `ffmpeg -c:v copy` without re-rendering video frames.
how: Upgrade `mix.py`: replace manual SFX cue estimation by running a headless timeline query on the HyperFrames composition to extract exact animation hits, generating stem audio prior to ffmpeg muxing.

title: Mechanical Anti-Slide Preflight Audit
text: Enforce automated layout linting before rendering: reject compositions if >= 3 sequential scenes simply toggle opacity/autoAlpha on static sections, enforce a maximum 2-tier text hierarchy per scene (headline + diegetic label), and flag camera scale changes under 5% as imperceptible Ken Burns drift. Ensure an anchor subject persists across >= 60% of runtime.

title: SVG Joint Proxy Transform Wrapper
text: GSAP `transformOrigin` on SVG elements dynamically recalculates based on dynamic bounding boxes, causing rotating joints (limbs, needles, dials) to tear apart during motion. Resolve this using a lightweight transform proxy object `J(el, tx, ty)` that writes explicit `translate() rotate() scale()` attribute strings during GSAP `onUpdate` without directly tweening SVG container coordinates.
how: Add the `J()` transform proxy helper to our base HyperFrames script template for animated props, dials, and future character rigging in Puraan Ki Katha.

title: Subtler Asymmetric Exit Rule
text: Exit animations must never mirror enter amplitude. Because viewer attention moves ahead to the next scene, exit tweens should use 40-60% smaller travel distance and faster duration than enters (e.g., enter: translateY 20px -> 0 over 400ms; exit: translateY 0 -> -8px over 250ms with 4px blur). Symmetrical exits distract from incoming focal subjects.
how: In `compose_lab.py` and `compose.py`, adjust all GSAP exit tweens for stat counters, clue cards, and HUD overlays to cut travel distance in half.

title: Text Reading Hold Duration Formula
text: Calculate required static hold durations for kinetic titles, cards, and text overlays using `duration = (word_count * 0.3s) + 0.5s` settle time. At 30 fps, a 3-word title needs at least 1.4s (42 frames) hold before transition or exit. Prevents visual cards and sentence highlights from disappearing before viewers can read them.
how: In `compose_lab.py`, enforce this formula when generating GSAP timeline hold durations for sentence captions and kinetic titles against TTS voice timings.

title: Materializing Blur-Translate Enter Preset
text: Replace harsh fade-ins or slide-ins with Jakub's materializing entrance: simultaneously animate `opacity: 0 -> 1`, `translateY: 8px -> 0px`, and `filter: blur(4px) -> blur(0px)` using a crisp ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) or zero-bounce spring over 300-450ms. Blur simulates depth and optical focus, giving UI props physical arrival on dark canvas.
how: In `compose_lab.py`, upgrade entrance tweens for UI panels, chat bubbles, stat counters, and comparison cards to include the `blur(4px)` to `blur(0px)` transition.

title: Ease-In Cut-On-Beat Scene Transition
text: When transitioning into a cut or musical downbeat, never let the outgoing motion settle with ease-out. If a card or camera push transitions across a cut, use ease-in (`cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.84, 0)`) so the cut lands at maximum velocity on or 1 frame before the downbeat, sustaining scene energy.
how: In `compose.py` and `compose_lab.py`, set outgoing push/pan tweens to ease-in (`power2.in`), aligning cut frame timestamps with downbeats detected in `mix.py`.

title: Non-Zero Scale Inception Guard
text: Never animate element scales starting from `scale(0)`. Starting an entrance from zero volume distorts visual aspect ratios and reads like an unnatural balloon inflating. Initialize entering badges, UI cards, and icon pops at `scale: 0.9` with `opacity: 0` before tweening to `scale: 1.0`.
how: In `compose_lab.py` and `preflight.py`, update and audit all GSAP pop-in tweens to clamp initial scale values to minimum `0.90`.

title: Windowed Latin Prompting for Hinglish Word Alignment
text: Whisper frequently hallucinates Devanagari or corrupts Romanized Hinglish phonetic spellings. Segment the planned Hinglish voice script into short time windows and pass the exact expected Romanized text as Whisper's initial_prompt (`--prompts`). This forces Whisper to preserve the intended Latin alphabet spelling (e.g., 'bhai', 'accha', 'jugaad') while producing precise millisecond-level word timestamps for kinetic light-up captions.
how: In `pace.py`, supply the generated Roman Hinglish script chunks into Whisper alignment as windowed prompts, ensuring 100% spelling fidelity for caption highlights in `compose_lab.py`.

title: India Shorts Trend Audio Scraper & Dual Master Export
text: Query YouTube Top Shorts India, Spotify India, and JioSaavn charts weekly to surface trending sounds. Never bake commercial trending music into exports due to Content ID copyright penalties. Instead, render two deliverables: a licensed-bed master, and an identical '_clean' video with music muted, providing metadata with the trending song title, artist, and start offset for in-app audio attachment.
how: Add a chart scraper script called by `scout.py`. In `compose.py` and `mix.py`, generate both standard and music-stripped `_clean` MP4s ready for platform trend tagging.

title: Multi-Check Pre-Delivery QA Matrix
text: Automate pre-delivery verification through programmatic ffmpeg checks: detect frozen video stretches (>1.5s identical frames via freezedetect), black frames at scene boundaries, WCAG flash safety violations (>3 flashes/sec or saturated red strobes), audio mono-fold phase cancellation, and empty or black frame 0. Block automated posting if any hard error is detected.
how: Expand `review.py` after rendering to run `freezedetect`, `blackdetect`, and first-frame validation before triggering Telegram approval in `publish.py`.

title: CSS 3D Perspective Rig for Prop and Panel Staging
text: Wrap composition scenes in container styling with perspective: 1000px and transform-style: preserve-3d, then animate elements along Z, rotateY, and rotateX (e.g., from z: -500, rotateY: 30, opacity: 0 with power3.out). This produces genuine 3D camera depth for floating cards and UI props without WebGL or Three.js dependencies.
how: In compose_lab.py, wrap UI panels and prop scene containers in .camera-container. Update GSAP scene timelines to animate rotateX/rotateY and z translations during entry transitions.

title: Scramble-Decode Headline Text Generator
text: Animate tech keyword reveals by iterating over string characters and cycling random glyphs (A-Z, 0-9, @#$%&*) at 30ms intervals across unresolved positions over 1.0 to 1.5 seconds until settling on the target text. Creates an authentic AI/decryption aesthetic for hook titles that outperforms standard terminal typing.
how: Embed the scrambleText helper in compose_lab.py HTML templates and invoke it for the primary hook keyword during the first 2 seconds of Kaise Tech explainers.

title: Dual-Layer CSS Chromatic Glitch Impact
text: Generate chromatic aberration without image filters by applying ::before and ::after pseudo-elements referencing content: attr(data-text). Shift the red channel -2px to -5px and cyan channel +2px to +5px while animating horizontal clip-path slices (e.g., inset(20% 0 80% 0)) during 0.3s impact hits.
how: Add .chromatic and .glitch-text CSS classes into compose_lab.py; tag high-energy hook titles or transition cards to receive the data-text attribute.

title: Subzone Graphic Intrusion Gate
text: To guarantee caption legibility in 9:16 vertical shorts (1080x1920), layout containers enforce a bottom safe margin of 490–570px (caption zone at y=1400–1520). Post-render audit extracts frames and measures high-contrast edge gradients (>24 pixel delta) inside the caption strip. Any non-caption visual card, chart, or prop entering the zone during speech triggers a layout collision reject.
how: Enforce a bottom safe container in compose_lab.py CSS, and add a numpy pixel-variance check over y=1400:1520 in review.py during voiced segments.

title: Bar-Spliced Pre-Drop Silent Stops
text: When arranging music for explainer drops, slice music tracks exclusively on 4-beat bar boundaries with 25 ms crossfades. Leave an empty gap of exactly 2 to 4 beats (half to full bar) immediately preceding high-energy drop sections. Place a standalone vocal shout line ('Look at this', 'Let's go') inside this silent window to maximize acoustic contrast.
how: Apply in `plan.py` and `mix.py`: insert a 2-beat silent stop right before major feature reveals and position the scene's kicker vocal inside that window.

title: Bake Complex CSS Gradients and Noise into PNG Tiles
text: Exceeding ~40 active DOM elements with live `radial-gradient`, CSS `filter: blur()`, or SVG `clip-path` causes headless Chromium/HyperFrames renderers to drop frames or render solid black rectangles. Replace procedural Ben-Day dots, noise grain, vignettes, and paper distress layers with static repeating PNG tiles using `background-image` or CSS `mask-image`.
how: Audit `compose_lab.py` and HTML templates; replace inline SVG noise filters and multiple layered CSS radial gradients with cached local PNG textures.

title: GSAP On-Twos Stepped Easing Quantizer
text: Emulate comic and hand-drawn stop-motion animation within GSAP timelines by quantizing continuous easing curves into 12 discrete steps per second: `on2(duration, baseEase) => gsap.parseEase(`steps(${Math.round(duration * 12)})`)`. Apply `on2` to character, UI card, and prop reveals while keeping camera pans, background drifts, and gradient fades continuous and smooth.
how: In `compose_lab.py`, add the `on2` helper to the template JavaScript header and wrap pop/slam animations during comic or lab tech callouts.

title: Dual-Band Beat-Grid and Kick Energy Fitter
text: Extract audio tempo and phase without Librosa using ffmpeg dual-stream decoding (full-band + 150 Hz low-pass) into numpy arrays. Compute RMS onset envelopes across 128-hop frames at 11 kHz and search candidate BPMs (100–130 at 0.02 step) and phase offsets (4 ms steps). Classify downbeats exceeding the 70th percentile low-band threshold as kick beats ('K') for visual triggering.
how: Build `beat_grid.py` using scipy/numpy; run on background music before `compose_lab.py` to populate beat timestamps (`B(n)`) and kick arrays for automated cut synchronization.

title: Speech-to-Music Stem Mix Balance Verification
text: Measure sidechain ducking levels by comparing isolated voice and music stems decoded at 8 kHz mono. Compute RMS dB separately for speech-active frames (`speech & body`) and silent pauses (`body & ~speech`). Enforce target balance: music must sit 4–6 dB below voice during speech and rise to voice level during pauses. Flag any ducking deeper than 8 dB as silent music defect.
how: Add `measure_mix_balance()` to `mix.py` or `review.py`. Generate temp stem WAVs before final loudnorm and abort render if ducking delta exceeds 7 dB.

title: Non-Semantic Audio-Reactive Mapping
text: When mapping audio features (RMS, Centroid, Onsets) to visual properties, avoid 'semantic overclaims' (e.g., assuming high frequency equals 'happiness'). Instead, use bounded, normalized, and smoothed mappings: RMS to scale, Onsets to opacity/flash, and Spectral Centroid to color-shift. Always provide a neutral fallback for silent segments to prevent visual 'jitter'.
how: Update 'mix.py' to export a normalized feature JSON. Update 'compose_lab.py' to use these values for property multipliers in GSAP animations.

title: Volatile Fact Verification Dating
text: API pricing, model IDs, and duration limits are 'volatile facts'. Every entry in our knowledge base must include a 'verified_on' date. If a fact is older than 30 days, the system must trigger a 'scout.py' check or warn the editor. This prevents using EOL models (like Nova Reel v1.0) or hitting stale pricing assumptions.
how: Update 'brain.jsonl' schema to require a 'verified_at' timestamp. Add a pre-flight check in 'doctor.py' to flag expired facts.

title: 2D Rig Viseme Inventory Rule
text: For future avatar work, do not use a fixed viseme count. Inventory must depend on the target language (Hinglish vs English). Ensure critical closures (M, B, P) are preserved. Use 'replacement' for hands/mouth poses to avoid 'volume collapse' seen in simple deformation/warping.
how: Add these rules to 'playbook.md' under a new 'Avatar' section to guide future development of 'compose_avatar.py'.

title: Precise Video Description (5-Aspect Rule)
text: When 'scout.py' or 'research.py' analyzes videos, it must use five distinct aspects: Subject, Scene, Motion, Spatial, and Camera. This prevents mixing 'creative intent' with 'literal observation'. For example, distinguish between 'subject-left' and 'frame-left' to ensure the AI-generated visuals match the script's spatial logic.
how: Update the system prompt in 'research.py' to enforce this 5-aspect structure for all visual analysis tasks.

title: Instruction-Guided TTS Performance
text: When using models like GPT-4o-audio, use 'instructions' for exact pronunciation of brand names (e.g., 'QuantaForge, pronounced KWON-tuh forge') and acting cues (e.g., 'conspiratorial and quieter'). Do not rely on phonetic spelling alone; use the 'instruction' field to set the 'warmth' or 'hype' level.

title: LLM Reasoning Evaluation (EVAL.md Pattern)
text: Implement a 'Reasoning Gate' using the repo's EVAL.md structure. Before any generation, the LLM must pass a 5-question quiz about the target model's constraints (e.g., 'What is the max duration for Kling lip-sync?', 'Does this model support SSML?'). If it fails, the job is blocked. This prevents 'hallucinated' parameters that lead to failed API calls or poor quality.
how: Add a 'reasoning_gate.py' step after 'plan.py'. It will generate a quiz based on the selected provider's constraints and verify the LLM's answers against our shared brain before allowing 'compose.py' to run.

title: D3.js Animated Data Visualization
text: Move beyond simple stat counters to full D3.js charts rendered to MP4. Use deterministic frame-based rendering (frame/fps) instead of wall-clock transitions to ensure every frame is identical across distributed renders. Requires frozen scales, fonts, and data joins to prevent 'morphing' errors where unrelated categories blend during sorts.
how: Create 'compose_data.py' using a headless browser to render D3.js templates. Integrate with 'HyperFrames' by passing a 'frame' variable to the D3 interpolators for perfect sync.

title: Lottie Vector Animation Integration
text: Use dotLottie/Lottie for high-quality, scalable vector overlays (icons, UI elements) instead of pre-rendered video clips. Use 'goToAndStop' frame-seeking for deterministic capture at 30fps. This reduces asset size and allows for dynamic color/text changes in 'Kaise Tech' explainers without re-rendering the base asset.

title: Three.js Deterministic 3D Props
text: Upgrade 'lab look' props from 2D images to 3D glTF models. Use Three.js with a fixed camera orbit and absolute-time animation (frame/fps). Ensure non-color data (normal, roughness) is not marked as sRGB to prevent 'washed out' textures. Dispose of GPU resources (geometries, textures) after every render to prevent memory leaks in long runs.

title: Automated Screen Demo Capture
text: For 'Kaise Tech' tutorials, use Playwright to capture authentic UI interactions. Avoid 'fixed sleeps'; instead, use 'assert observable state' (wait for element). Distinguish between 'authentic' (real UI) and 'illustrative' (mocked UI) and disclose accordingly. Capture at 2x scale for 'Kaise Tech' zoom-ins to maintain text readability.

title: 120 BPM Structural Grid
text: Standardize all video pacing on a 120 BPM grid (0.5s per beat). Structural events like slams, landings, and cuts must land on beats or 16ths (0.125s). Repeated units (like story 'asks' or scenes) should use a whole number of beats (e.g., 11 beats/5.5s) to prevent the visual rhythm from drifting away from the music over time.

title: FLIP Object Continuity
text: Use the FLIP (First, Last, Invert, Play) principle for transitions. An element (like an avatar or card) should fly to the exact rect of its counterpart in the next scene. The receiving scene takes over on the landing frame. This 'continuity over cuts' approach makes automated edits feel like high-end custom motion graphics.
how: Apply this in plan.py by identifying 'carrier' objects that persist across scenes and ensuring their end-rect in Scene 1 matches the start-rect in Scene 2.

title: Shared Timing Spine (layout.js)
text: Centralize all timestamps, shared geometry (rects), and content strings into a single 'spine' file (assets/lib/layout.js). Every composition and the audio engine import this file. This ensures that when a UI card moves, the sound effect and the next scene's handoff rect are perfectly aligned without hard-coding values in multiple places.

title: Spine-Driven Procedural Scoring
text: Replace static music beds with a procedural audio engine (using seeded noise/oscillators) that synthesizes a score based on the layout spine. This allows for 'signature motifs' for characters and 'marks' (whooshes, clicks, hits) to be generated exactly on the frame where the visual event occurs, normalized to -16 LUFS.

title: CSS 3D Head-on Stage
text: Implement a CSS-3D world using perspective (e.g., 1100px) where UI cards always face the camera (no rotation). Depth is achieved via camera dolly (z-axis), parallax, and focus pulls. This 'head-on' rule ensures text remains readable while providing a premium 3D feel. Use a 'follow cam' with Hann-smoothed look-ahead for tracking moving elements.

title: Mathematical Character Rigging
text: Convert static mascot rasters into rigged SVG modules. Use marching squares for tracing, Douglas-Peucker for simplification, and Catmull-Rom splines for smoothing. Create 'rigs' as pure functions of time for nodding, blinking, and 'thinking' (flickering points via sine waves). This allows faceless characters to react to the script without manual animation.

title: Dual-Side Transition Snapshots
text: Improve the visual audit by capturing snapshots exactly one frame before and one frame after every transition/handoff. Compare these frames to ensure 'pixel-identical' handoffs where an object in Scene A perfectly matches its position in Scene B. This eliminates 'jumps' or 'stray frames' during complex transitions.

title: LLMS.txt Verbatim Extraction
text: Prioritize 'llms.txt' or 'llms-full.txt' files when researching tech products. These files provide clean, verbatim technical truths (API endpoints, feature names) without DOM clutter. Ensure every on-screen claim is traced to a specific URL in RESEARCH.md to prevent AI hallucinations in explainers.

title: Reference Energy Mapping
text: Analyze reference videos for a 'stillness ratio' (target >25% dead-still) and 'bursts' (>=3 changes in 1.5s). Use a character-based energy map ( .:-=+*#%@) to visualize motion density and ensure the edit 'breathes'.

title: Rhythm Variance Rule
text: Ensure shot lengths vary by at least 4x (e.g., 0.25s words next to 2.5s holds). The Coefficient of Variation (CV) for shot lengths should be >= 0.25 to avoid a 'metronome' or 'slideshow' feel.
how: Add a validation step in plan.py to calculate the CV of the generated scene durations. If CV < 0.25, re-prompt Gemini to vary the pacing.

title: Camera Air & Depth SFX
text: Generate 'air' noise (band-passed 150Hz-9kHz) scaled by camera velocity (|d log zoom / dt|^1.3). Closer zoom = brighter noise. Adds physical presence to digital camera moves.
how: In mix.py, generate a procedural noise track based on the camera's zoom velocity exported from the animation metadata.

title: Continuity Carry Oracle
text: Measure 'carry score' at scene boundaries. A boundary is 'carried' if an element survives and moves >2% diagonal or scales >10%. Reject videos with score <0.5. Prevents 'slideshow' feel where scenes just replace each other.
how: Add a 'carry check' to preflight.py. Use the GSAP timeline to verify at least one object ID persists across scene transitions with significant transform changes.

title: UI Replica System
text: Instead of screen recordings, rebuild UI in HTML/CSS. This allows infinite zoom without pixelation, instant language swapping via string tables, and programmatic control of every state (hover, click, active).
how: Upgrade compose_lab.py to generate HTML components for 'tech explainers' rather than using static images. Use a 'stage' helper to manage scaling and crispness at high zooms.

title: Shutter-Based Motion Blur
text: Render moving frames by averaging multiple sub-frame captures (4-48 samples) across a 180-degree shutter. Essential for moves >80px/frame to prevent strobing. Only apply to 'moving' frames to save render time.
how: Modify the rendering loop in compose.py to take multiple screenshots per frame during high-velocity GSAP segments and blend them using ffmpeg or canvas globalAlpha.

title: Event-Driven SFX Scoring
text: Export an __events() JSON from the animation containing exact timestamps, pans (screen X), and impact strengths. Use this to drive score.py to place foley (clicks, whooshes, thuds) with sub-millisecond precision.
how: Update compose.py to emit a JSON of GSAP 'onStart' events. Feed this to mix.py to automate SFX placement instead of relying on manual timeline mining.

title: Screen-Space Camera Rig
text: A camera rig that chases the subject's screen position and log-zoom, not world position. This ensures that a 'landing' or 'zoom' feels identical whether the subject is at 1x or 300x scale.
how: Implement a 'rig' function in layout.js that calculates CSS transforms based on a target element's desired screen-center coordinates rather than absolute offsets.

title: Language Time-Warping
text: Map animation beats to specific words in different languages using 'knots' [filmT, authorT]. Allows the same visual composition to sync perfectly with English and Hinglish VO even when sentence lengths differ.
how: In plan.py, anchor visual 'hits' to specific words in the script. Use a time-warping function in compose.py to adjust the GSAP timeline speed based on TTS word timings.
